description: Arkheionx finding-to-test-plan map for defensive local test planning and Foundry invariant skeleton generation.
safety_notice: Generated test plans are starter scaffolds for authorized repositories. They are not a formal audit, not formal verification, and require human review.

ARK-TST-001.title: No Solidity tests detected
suggested_tests: Add deterministic unit tests for the primary deposit, withdraw, borrow, swap, claim, or admin lifecycle.
Add at least one negative test for unauthorized or invalid user actions.
Document the local test command expected to pass before audit handoff.
invariant_candidates: Protocol lifecycle actions should preserve documented accounting relationships.
Unauthorized callers should not mutate critical state.
safety_notes: Use local test deployments only.
Replace TODOs with repository-specific bindings.
confidence_notes: This is a broad readiness gap when no Solidity test files are visible.
manual_review_notes: Confirm whether tests live outside the scanned root before treating this as a blocker.

ARK-TST-002.title: No invariant tests detected for DeFi protocol shape
suggested_tests: Add a stateful invariant suite for the core protocol lifecycle.
Add handler actions for normal user flows and documented edge cases.
Add conservation properties for assets, shares, rewards, debt, or reserves as applicable.
invariant_candidates: Core accounting relationships hold after any allowed user action.
Privileged actions cannot silently bypass documented accounting assumptions.
required_project_bindings: Local mocks for assets and oracle inputs
safety_notes: Generated invariants are starting points and need human tailoring.
confidence_notes: Confidence increases when protocol-like value flows exist and invariant test evidence is absent.
manual_review_notes: Review whether the protocol uses another property-testing framework outside Foundry.

ARK-VLT-001.title: Vault accounting without invariant tests
suggested_tests: Add a totalAssets/share supply conservation invariant.
Add deposit/withdraw roundtrip tests across multiple users.
Test donation and low-supply states against documented rounding policy.
invariant_candidates: totalAssets remains consistent with local asset accounting and documented strategy value.
Deposit and withdraw sequences do not create unaccounted value beyond documented rounding.
safety_notes: Use mock assets and local vault deployment only.
confidence_notes: Strong when ERC4626/vault terms exist without invariant tests.
manual_review_notes: Check whether strategy balances are intentionally externalized.

ARK-VLT-002.title: ERC4626-like interface without preview function tests
suggested_tests: Test previewDeposit/previewMint/previewWithdraw/previewRedeem against state-changing equivalents.
Cover zero supply, low supply, and high supply states.
Document any intentional divergence from ERC4626 expectations.
invariant_candidates: Preview and conversion functions remain mutually consistent within documented rounding.
safety_notes: Keep assertions local and project-specific.
confidence_notes: Medium when preview terms are absent from tests but ERC4626-like flows exist.
manual_review_notes: Confirm whether the repository intentionally implements a partial interface.

ARK-VLT-003.title: Shares/assets conversion without rounding tests
suggested_tests: Test convertToShares and convertToAssets roundtrip behavior.
Cover dust amounts and decimal mismatch cases.
Assert rounding direction matches documentation.
invariant_candidates: Share/asset conversions remain bounded by documented rounding policy.
safety_notes: Avoid assuming perfect equality when rounding is documented.
confidence_notes: High when conversion functions exist and rounding tests are missing.
manual_review_notes: Review any inherited library behavior before adding duplicate assertions.

ARK-VLT-004.title: totalAssets external dependency without manipulation-resistance tests
suggested_tests: Mock external balance or strategy value changes and assert totalAssets behavior.
Test donation sensitivity and balance drift handling.
Document whether external balances are trusted assumptions.
invariant_candidates: External asset movements cannot silently break documented totalAssets assumptions.
safety_notes: Use synthetic local balance changes only.
confidence_notes: Medium to high when totalAssets depends on external balances or strategy values.
manual_review_notes: Check whether accounting intentionally includes idle donations.

ARK-VLT-005.title: Strategy accounting without gain/loss tests
suggested_tests: Mock strategy gain and loss events.
Test harvest/report lifecycle accounting.
Assert user share value changes follow documented policy.
invariant_candidates: Strategy gain/loss reports keep vault accounting internally consistent.
safety_notes: Do not connect to production strategy endpoints.
confidence_notes: High when strategy terms exist without lifecycle tests.
manual_review_notes: Review strategy trust assumptions and withdrawal latency.

ARK-VLT-006.title: Withdrawal queue/cooldown without lifecycle tests
suggested_tests: Test request, cooldown, claim, cancel, and expiry transitions.
Assert shares/assets are conserved through delayed withdrawal lifecycle.
Cover paused and emergency-withdrawal behavior if present.
invariant_candidates: Withdrawal lifecycle transitions conserve user claims and vault accounting.
safety_notes: Use local time-step controls or explicit test helpers only.
confidence_notes: High when delayed withdrawal terms exist without lifecycle tests.
manual_review_notes: Check whether queue behavior depends on off-chain operators.

ARK-VLT-007.title: Fee logic without fee accounting tests
suggested_tests: Test fee accrual, collection, and cap enforcement.
Assert fees cannot exceed documented bounds.
Cover fee changes by authorized roles.
invariant_candidates: Fee accounting remains bounded and attributable to documented fee paths.
safety_notes: Use synthetic amounts and local accounts.
confidence_notes: Medium when fee terms exist without dedicated tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether fee math is delegated to a shared library.

ARK-VLT-008.title: Pause/emergency controls without operational tests
suggested_tests: Test pause blocks risky flows and preserves documented recovery paths.
Test emergency functions under authorized and unauthorized callers.
Document expected behavior for deposits, withdrawals, and claims while paused.
invariant_candidates: Pause state prevents risky flows without corrupting accounting state.
safety_notes: Keep emergency-flow tests local and non-destructive.
confidence_notes: Medium when pause/emergency terms exist without operational tests.
manual_review_notes: Check whether emergency controls are intentionally owner-trusted.

ARK-VLT-009.title: Vault accounting lacks visible roundtrip or conservation coverage
suggested_tests: Add deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem roundtrip tests.
Add share supply and asset conservation checks.
Cover multi-user rounding behavior.
invariant_candidates: User roundtrips do not create unaccounted value across normal vault lifecycle.
safety_notes: Use local mocks and documented rounding tolerance.
confidence_notes: Medium when vault signals exist with weak test coverage.
manual_review_notes: Review if tests are generated or located outside the repository.

ARK-ORC-001.title: Oracle-dependent logic without stale-price tests
suggested_tests: Reject stale oracle rounds or document fallback behavior.
Test updatedAt or heartbeat boundaries.
Test borrow, liquidation, vault, or reward flows when oracle data is stale.
invariant_candidates: Accounting decisions only use oracle data that satisfies documented freshness policy.
safety_notes: Use local mock oracle responses only.
confidence_notes: High when oracle calls exist and stale-price tests are absent.
manual_review_notes: Check whether freshness validation is implemented in an imported adapter.

ARK-ORC-002.title: Oracle decimals or normalization not covered by tests
suggested_tests: Test decimals normalization across expected feed decimals.
Test zero, negative, or invalid oracle answers if applicable.
Assert normalized price units match accounting units.
invariant_candidates: Normalized oracle values remain within documented unit and decimal assumptions.
safety_notes: Use synthetic feed answers and local mocks.
confidence_notes: Medium to high when decimals or price terms exist without normalization tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether feed decimals are fixed at deployment.

ARK-ORC-003.title: Spot or reserve-based pricing without manipulation-resistance tests
suggested_tests: Test spot-price movement bounds.
Test TWAP or delay assumptions when used.
Document reserve-price dependency and expected safeguards.
invariant_candidates: Price-dependent accounting does not rely on an undocumented instantaneous reserve ratio.
safety_notes: Use local reserve changes and avoid production market assumptions.
confidence_notes: High when reserve price terms exist without manipulation-resistance tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether price source is advisory or authoritative.

ARK-ORC-004.title: Oracle setter/admin path without role-boundary tests
suggested_tests: Test unauthorized callers cannot change oracle configuration.
Test authorized oracle changes emit expected events if applicable.
Document emergency oracle rotation procedure.
invariant_candidates: Only documented roles can mutate oracle configuration.
safety_notes: Use local accounts for role tests.
confidence_notes: Medium when oracle setter/admin signals appear without negative tests.
manual_review_notes: Review deployment scripts for transferred ownership.

ARK-ORC-005.title: Missing price bounds or fallback assumptions documentation
suggested_tests: Test documented price bounds.
Test invalid answer fallback behavior.
Add documentation for price shock and fallback assumptions.
invariant_candidates: Invalid or out-of-bound price inputs cannot silently drive critical accounting decisions.
safety_notes: Use local invalid-value mocks.
confidence_notes: Medium when oracle use exists with weak assumption documentation.
manual_review_notes: Review whether fallback behavior is intentionally unavailable.

ARK-ACC-001.title: Privileged setters without role-boundary tests
suggested_tests: Test unauthorized callers cannot change critical parameters.
Test authorized role can perform expected setter actions.
Document role ownership and transfer procedure.
invariant_candidates: Unauthorized users cannot mutate privileged configuration.
safety_notes: Use local role accounts only.
confidence_notes: High when admin setters exist without negative tests.
manual_review_notes: Review role inheritance and deployment ownership transfer.

ARK-ACC-002.title: Emergency or rescue functions without documented constraints
suggested_tests: Test emergency/rescue functions under authorized and unauthorized callers.
Assert rescue paths cannot remove unsupported assets contrary to documentation.
Document emergency constraints and expected operator behavior.
invariant_candidates: Emergency paths preserve documented user-accounting assumptions.
safety_notes: Use local mock balances only.
confidence_notes: Medium when rescue/emergency terms exist without constraints.
manual_review_notes: Check whether emergency powers are intentionally trusted and disclosed.

ARK-ACC-003.title: Admin role concentration not documented
suggested_tests: Document role concentration and expected multisig/timelock controls.
Test role transfer and revoke behavior.
Test guardian or pause roles separately from owner roles.
invariant_candidates: Role transitions preserve access boundaries and do not strand critical controls.
safety_notes: Do not include production signer details in generated tests.
confidence_notes: Low to medium when role concentration is inferred from source or docs.
manual_review_notes: Confirm whether operational controls are documented outside the repository.

ARK-UPG-001.title: Upgradeable contract without initializer/upgrade tests
suggested_tests: Test initializer can only run once.
Test unauthorized upgrades are rejected.
Run a local upgrade simulation that preserves key accounting state.
invariant_candidates: Initialization and upgrade paths preserve documented state and access boundaries.
safety_notes: Use local proxy simulation or project test harness only.
confidence_notes: High when upgradeability terms exist without initializer tests.
manual_review_notes: Review storage layout separately with project tooling.

ARK-UPG-002.title: Storage layout or upgrade assumptions not documented
suggested_tests: Document storage layout assumptions.
Test upgrade authorization and post-upgrade critical flows.
Add regression checks for storage slot-sensitive state.
invariant_candidates: Post-upgrade state remains consistent for balances, roles, and configuration.
safety_notes: Keep upgrade simulations local.
confidence_notes: Medium when upgrade assumptions are visible but documentation is weak.
manual_review_notes: Review deployment process and upgrade runbooks.

ARK-REENT-001.title: Value flow with external calls needs reentrancy review
suggested_tests: Add a benign callback-capable receiver stub.
Assert state updates happen before external value transfer where required.
Test withdraw, claim, refund, or swap flows for accounting consistency.
invariant_candidates: External-call flows cannot observe or preserve inconsistent accounting state.
safety_notes: Use a harmless local receiver stub with TODO assertions.
confidence_notes: Medium to high when external calls and value flows are detected.
manual_review_notes: Review inherited guards and pull-payment patterns.

ARK-REENT-002.title: Callback-capable token or receiver path detected
suggested_tests: Use a local callback-capable token or receiver stub.
Assert callbacks cannot mutate unexpected lifecycle state.
Document supported token assumptions.
invariant_candidates: Callback-capable paths preserve lifecycle state and documented token assumptions.
safety_notes: Use only synthetic local stubs.
confidence_notes: Medium when callback-capable patterns appear without coverage.
manual_review_notes: Check whether non-standard tokens are explicitly unsupported.

ARK-REENT-003.title: Claim/refund flow without state-transition tests
suggested_tests: Test claim/refund state transitions before and after value transfer.
Test double-claim and repeated refund attempts.
Assert failed external transfers do not corrupt claim state.
invariant_candidates: Claimable accounting decreases exactly once for each successful claim or refund.
safety_notes: Keep transfer behavior local and synthetic.
confidence_notes: High when claim/refund terms exist without transition tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether the flow uses pull payments.

ARK-REENT-004.title: External call path without documented ordering assumptions
suggested_tests: Document checks-effects-interactions or guard assumptions.
Test state before and after external calls.
Assert failure paths preserve accounting state.
invariant_candidates: External call ordering follows documented state-transition policy.
safety_notes: Use local failure-mode stubs only.
confidence_notes: Low to medium when ordering cannot be inferred strongly.
manual_review_notes: Review code paths manually before deciding severity.

ARK-RWD-001.title: Reward accounting without conservation tests
suggested_tests: Assert funded rewards cover claimed plus remaining claimable amounts.
Test stake, unstake, claim, and notify reward lifecycle.
Cover multi-user reward distribution.
invariant_candidates: Claimed rewards plus remaining claimable rewards do not exceed funded rewards beyond documented rounding.
safety_notes: Use local reward funding only.
confidence_notes: High when reward terms exist without conservation tests.
manual_review_notes: Review reward funding and emergency recovery assumptions.

ARK-RWD-002.title: Accumulator/index logic without precision/rounding tests
suggested_tests: Test reward index monotonicity.
Cover small balances and precision edge cases.
Test repeated updates with zero and nonzero supply.
invariant_candidates: Reward index remains monotonic and supply-aware within documented rounding.
safety_notes: Use synthetic time or explicit update helpers.
confidence_notes: High when accumulator/index terms exist without precision tests.
manual_review_notes: Review precision constants and decimal assumptions.

ARK-RWD-003.title: Claim flow without double-claim prevention tests
suggested_tests: Test repeated claim attempts after successful claim.
Test claim after stake/unstake boundary transitions.
Assert paid amounts update before repeatable state is exposed.
invariant_candidates: Each reward increment can be claimed at most once per entitled account.
safety_notes: Use local reward token mocks.
confidence_notes: High when claim terms exist without double-claim tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether rewards are streamed, escrowed, or checkpointed.

ARK-RWD-004.title: Lock/cooldown reward lifecycle not tested
suggested_tests: Test lock, cooldown, unstake, and claim ordering.
Test early exit restrictions if applicable.
Assert reward checkpointing around lifecycle boundaries.
invariant_candidates: Lifecycle transitions preserve user stake and reward checkpoints.
safety_notes: Use local time helpers only.
confidence_notes: Medium when lock/cooldown terms appear without tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether lifecycle state is delegated to another module.

ARK-RWD-005.title: Emission/admin update assumptions not documented
suggested_tests: Test authorized and unauthorized emission updates.
Test emission changes before and after reward claims.
Document allowed operator behavior and funding assumptions.
invariant_candidates: Emission updates cannot invalidate already accrued reward accounting.
safety_notes: Use local operator accounts only.
confidence_notes: Medium when admin/emission terms appear without documentation.
manual_review_notes: Review funding source and emission cap assumptions.

ARK-AMM-001.title: AMM invariant assumptions not covered by tests
suggested_tests: Assert swaps preserve the documented constant-product or stableswap invariant within fee and rounding bounds.
Test repeated swaps across small and large reserve states.
Document expected invariant tolerance.
invariant_candidates: Swaps and liquidity operations preserve documented AMM accounting within expected fee and rounding bounds.
safety_notes: Use toy/local reserves and no production market assumptions.
confidence_notes: High when swap/reserve terms exist without invariant tests.
manual_review_notes: Review exact AMM curve before choosing assertion tolerance.

ARK-AMM-002.title: LP share accounting without mint/burn boundary tests
suggested_tests: Test first liquidity provider behavior.
Test proportional minting and proportional withdrawal.
Cover rounding and dust handling during mint/burn.
invariant_candidates: LP share supply tracks pool ownership within documented rounding.
safety_notes: Use local token mocks and project-specific rounding tolerance.
confidence_notes: High when mint/burn/liquidity terms exist without boundary tests.
manual_review_notes: Review minimum-liquidity and initial-share policy.

ARK-AMM-003.title: Spot-price or reserve-price dependency without manipulation-resistance tests
suggested_tests: Test reserve-price movement bounds.
Test TWAP or delay assumptions if used.
Document whether other accounting paths rely on spot reserve price.
invariant_candidates: Reserve-based price consumers respect documented bounds and delay assumptions.
safety_notes: Use local reserve changes only.
confidence_notes: High when quote/getAmountOut/reserve price terms exist without bounds tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether price output is advisory or used for critical accounting.

ARK-AMM-004.title: Fee-on-transfer or non-standard token assumptions not documented
suggested_tests: Test actual received amount accounting with balanceBefore/balanceAfter pattern.
Simulate fee-on-transfer behavior with a local mock if supported.
Document unsupported token types if not handled.
invariant_candidates: Pool accounting uses actual received token amounts or explicitly rejects unsupported tokens.
required_project_bindings: Token mock with configurable received amount
safety_notes: Use synthetic local token behavior only.
confidence_notes: Medium when transfer assumptions exist without documentation or received-amount tests.
manual_review_notes: Review token support policy before adding mocks.

ARK-AMM-005.title: Slippage/min-output constraints missing or unclear
suggested_tests: Test minOut enforcement.
Test stale quote or deadline behavior if supported.
Assert user-provided slippage bounds are respected.
invariant_candidates: Swap execution respects user-provided output bounds and documented deadline policy.
safety_notes: Use local swap state and synthetic users.
confidence_notes: High when swap paths lack visible minOut/deadline/slippage terms.
manual_review_notes: Review whether slippage is enforced by a router outside this repository.

ARK-LEND-001.title: Collateral/debt solvency invariant not covered by tests
suggested_tests: Assert solvent positions remain solvent after deposit, borrow, repay, and withdraw flows.
Test debt cannot exceed documented collateral constraints.
Test unsafe withdrawals are rejected or explicitly documented.
invariant_candidates: Collateral value and debt remain inside documented solvency constraints after allowed user actions.
safety_notes: Use local price and balance mocks only.
confidence_notes: High when borrow/debt/collateral terms exist without solvency invariants.
manual_review_notes: Review collateral factor and price-unit assumptions.

ARK-LEND-002.title: Liquidation boundary tests missing
suggested_tests: Test just-above-threshold positions cannot be liquidated.
Test just-below-threshold positions can be liquidated according to policy.
Assert liquidation bonus and close factor stay within documented bounds.
invariant_candidates: Liquidation eligibility changes only at documented threshold boundaries.
safety_notes: Use local threshold setup and synthetic accounts.
confidence_notes: High when liquidation terms exist without boundary tests.
manual_review_notes: Review rounding around exact threshold values.

ARK-LEND-003.title: Interest/index accounting not covered by rounding and time-step tests
suggested_tests: Test interest or borrow index monotonicity.
Cover small balances and repeated accrual.
Test borrow and repay before and after accrual.
invariant_candidates: Interest and borrow indexes move according to documented rate policy and do not drift unexpectedly.
safety_notes: Use local time-step helpers or explicit accrual calls.
confidence_notes: High when index/accrual terms exist without rounding tests.
manual_review_notes: Review whether index math is inherited from a shared library.

ARK-LEND-004.title: Oracle-dependent borrowing/liquidation without stale-price tests
suggested_tests: Test stale oracle rejection for borrow and liquidation paths.
Test decimals normalization for collateral valuation.
Test price shock boundaries around health-factor transitions.
invariant_candidates: Borrowing and liquidation decisions only use oracle data that satisfies documented validity policy.
safety_notes: Use local oracle values and synthetic price shocks.
confidence_notes: High when lending health logic depends on oracle signals without stale-price tests.
manual_review_notes: Review fallback behavior and collateral-specific feed assumptions.

ARK-LEND-005.title: Reserve/cash accounting assumptions not covered
suggested_tests: Test borrow cannot exceed available liquidity.
Test repay updates cash, debt, and reserves consistently.
Assert reserves cannot be withdrawn beyond documented constraints.
invariant_candidates: Cash, total borrows, total reserves, and utilization remain internally consistent.
safety_notes: Use local asset mocks and synthetic liquidity.
confidence_notes: High when reserve/cash/utilization terms exist without accounting tests.
manual_review_notes: Review reserve factor and protocol fee accounting.

ARK-LEND-006.title: Liquidation/access-control interaction not documented
suggested_tests: Test liquidator restrictions if the market uses allowlists or keepers.
Test paused-market liquidation behavior.
Assert emergency roles cannot bypass documented liquidation constraints.
invariant_candidates: Liquidation and emergency controls preserve documented role boundaries.
safety_notes: Use local accounts and documented role assumptions.
confidence_notes: Medium when liquidation and admin role terms appear together without documentation.
manual_review_notes: Review whether liquidations are intentionally permissioned.
